source_name: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd (MSEDCL), consumer portal
text: MSEDCL: Dear Consumer 170012345678, electricity bill of Rs. 3,450 for Aug-26 remains unpaid. Please pay before 15-10-2026, otherwise your power supply will be disconnected as per notice u/s 56 of the Electricity Act. Pay online at https://wss.mahadiscom.in/wss/wss or on the MSEDCL mobile app. Ignore if already paid.
